text:
If your plans are outside, the day is starting cooler and grayer than advertised, with Burlington at 66 under cloudy skies and a light south breeze. There’s still time for some breaks and a warmer afternoon, but the forecast is uncertain enough that I wouldn’t count on a full run at 78. The lake is a different story, with a wind advisory on the broad waters, though winds should ease and turn northerly late this afternoon. Waves will settle from 1 to 3 feet to a foot or less.

Tonight looks quiet but mostly cloudy, with a low near 58. Thursday is another mild, mostly cloudy day, near 75, with showers possible after noon as a front moves through. Most of the day should stay dry, but I’d keep rain gear handy for the afternoon and evening. Good for a short waterfront outing today, but check the lake before heading out and don’t plan a long exposed paddle.
